sloka: एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ।नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं ते वरमन्यं वृणीष्व मे ।। ७.१०.१७ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastadā brahmā daśagrīvamuvāca ha ।nāsti sarvāmaratvaṁ te varamanyaṁ vṛṇīṣva me ।। 7.10.17 ॥

translations.english: When thus addressed, Brahma then said to Dashagriva that complete immortality was not possible for him, and he should choose another boon from him.
